title: United States Military Rail Road Photographic Album
institution: Library of Congress, Prints and Photographs Division
stock: 108 albumen print photographs in one bound physical album, original digital page-turner and item-specific catalogued stock dimensions.
object_provenance: Library of Congress catalog traces the album through R. K. Hawley and General Winfield Scott Hancock; purchased in 2018 from 19th Century Rare Book & Photograph Shop.

same_copy_vendor_catalog.evidence: The matching Hancock–Hawley provenance and count identify this volume. The catalog describes 108 albumen prints mounted on heavy stock, with most captions on separate slips. Its illustrations are low resolution. Native capture independence requires the library rasters.

page_number_rule: Page values are printed catalog page numbers, not IIIF canvas or presentation-sequence indices. Cross-map each catalog item to a downloaded canvas by title, text and visible image content before recording a file as a match.
rights_status: The volume's MARC 540 field and the page-38 item report no known restrictions on publication. The MARC 506 field requires appointments to access the physical volume. Verify each other asset's item-level advisory.

references.title: Front of "slave pen," Alexandria, Va.
references.landmark_evidence: The catalog cites the independently held public-domain negative. After image matching it can corroborate interior landmarks. The extent of this album print and its visible motif require the album leaf and the item capture.
